blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Enteric Coated to Avoid Upset Stomach, Aftertaste & Reflux!

EPA and DHA are important Omega-3 fatty acids that support cardiovascular health as well as being important components of the cells in the body. 21st Century Fish Oil contains high quality molecularly distilled fish oil concentrate.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, adults take one (1) softgel with any meal, up to three (3) times daily or as directed by a healthcare provider. Do not exceed recommended dosage.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Gelatin, vegetable glycerin, purified water, mixed tocopherols. Coating (sodium alginate, stearic acid, ethylcellulose, medium chain triglycerides, ammonium hydroxide, oleic acid, vanillin).
Contains soy and fish (anchovy, cod, herring, mackerel, salmon, sardine and sprat).
No added sugar, salt, yeast, artificial flavors or colors.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Consult a healthcare provider prior to use if pregnant, nursing, taking medications, including blood thinners, have a medical condition or are planning a medical procedure. Stop use and contact a physician if adverse reactions occur.
Keep out of reach of children.
Do not use if product appears to be tampered with or seal is broken. Store in a cool, dry place.
